summary: A child chat (flag hub_children) that stops on a usage limit tells its parent once. The agent exits after the limit, and that session end wrote a second, false update, "failed: Failed: its agent process ended with an error.", beside the "limited" one; with the auto-resume armed the registry now writes none for a session end, and the next end writes failed as before once the row disarms. The update a child sent also stayed on its row after it ran again, so a child moved to another account with move_child read "Working: Failed: its agent process ended with an error." for an hour and list_children kept lastUpdate failed. A child's status: running now marks its stored updates stale (hub_wakes.stale_at), so the hub view's lastWake, the desktop Children strip and list_children show the state alone until its next update. The rows stay stored, are still delivered to the parent, and read_child still points at them.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo app only renders the hub view the backend sends: apps/mobile/src/components/HubChildrenRow.tsx prints childStateLabel plus child.lastWake.summary and keeps no copy across launches, so the backend fix reaches it with no app change.

nativeAndroid.reason: Native Android only renders the hub view the backend sends: HubChildren.decode parses lastWake and ThreadScreen's HubChildRow prints it, with the view held in memory only, so the backend fix reaches it with no app change.

automated: tests/unit/hub-limits-registry.test.ts: a child whose agent exits after a usage limit leaves one update of kind limited and stays Limited with its auto-resume armed; move_child to another account leaves the row Working with no update, and the limited update stays pending for the parent.
tests/unit/hub-db.test.ts: markHubChildWakesStale takes a wake out of lastHubWakes once, leaves it in listPendingHubWakes and lastHubWakeOf, and a newer wake shows again.
tests/unit/hub-stop-registry.test.ts and tests/unit/hub-wakes.test.ts: the stopped, failed and blocked wakes, one per task, and the delivery rules are unchanged.
notExercised: Not run in a packaged app: hub_children is off by default and the change needs a parent chat whose child hits a five-hour limit.

A child on another machine (hub_remote_children, off by default) still shows the update its hub imported until the next one arrives: the hub runs no turn of its own for it, so nothing there marks the imported row stale. The child's own machine clears it for its own view.
